title: TrustLens Published Knowledge Bundle Manifest
description: Phase 2 WP8 (ADR-0004). The contract for the manifest of an immutable, versioned TrustLens knowledge bundle. A bundle is a deterministic projection of a git commit containing only the runtime-necessary knowledge (rules, indicators, negative library, taxonomy/dimensions, schemas, evidence METADATA) — never raw PDFs, test corpora or validators. The manifest pins every component version, records a SHA-256 per file and a content digest over the whole set, so a runtime decision can answer exactly which knowledge executed and be reproduced. commit_sha and created_at are provenance and are DELIBERATELY excluded from content_digest so that the same commit always yields the same digest.

manifest_schema_version.description: Version of THIS manifest contract. Const per revision (KB-001 §8).

bundle_version.description: Semantic version of the bundle format/content contract.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 build instant. Provenance only — NOT part of content_digest, so builds remain reproducible.

commit_sha.description: The git commit the bundle was built from (from GITHUB_SHA or .git/HEAD), or 'unknown' when built outside a work tree. Provenance only — not part of content_digest.

gate.description: Whether the publication quality gate passed for this build. NOT_RECORDED unless a publish step explicitly asserts PASS — the builder never claims a gate it did not observe.

content_digest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted set of '<bundle_path>=<sha256>' lines for every included file. The reproducible identity of the bundle's knowledge content.

component_versions.description: The pinned semantic version of every knowledge component in the bundle (STEP 7).

counts.description: Informative counts for humans and quick sanity checks (rules_total, rules_published, positive/negative indicators, taxonomy categories/subcategories, dimension terms, files).
